answer: Influence is earned only through a single prepaid settlement inlet per key. The inlet is a unidirectional payment channel that must stay collateralized by a non-transferable sable bond sitting at or above a published liquidity ridge. Channel identifiers are unique; if two keys share an inlet or the sable bond falls below the ridge, both channels are closed and the bonds burned. To run N identities, an attacker opens N independent inlets, locks N sable bonds above the ridge, and prepays N streams of settlement, so locked capital and prepaid liquidity scale with farm size.
